crew.overview: Shouya Ishida starts bullying the new girl in class, Shouko Nishimiya, because she is deaf. But as the teasing continues, the rest of the class starts to turn on Shouya for his lack of compassion. When they leave elementary school, Shouko and Shouya do not speak to each other again... until an older, wiser Shouya, tormented by his past behaviour, decides he must see Shouko once more. He wants to atone for his sins, but is it already too late...?
crew.title: A Silent Voice: The Movie

details.biography: Hiromune Kurahashi (倉橋裕宗 Kurahashi Hiromune) is a Japanese sound effects designer. He graduated from Kokushikan University's Faculty of Business Administration. After studying at Canterbury Christ Church University in the UK and completing a one-year training for emerging overseas artists in the sound effects field of the film department in Paris, France, he returned to Japan and joined Soundbox, which he left again in 2015 to found his own company Otonarium.
details.name: Hiromune Kurahashi
